title: What the Bearded Vulture means

is_this_you.pressure: Push you and you get slower and harder to read, which is when the people pushing should start to worry.
is_this_you.love: You take years to choose. Then you build more than one home with them, and keep every one in repair.
is_this_you.cost: You let people keep a wrong idea of you for years, because explaining feels like begging.

opener.text: The Persians told of the Huma, a bird of luck [s9]. If its shadow passed over you, you would rise to be king [s9]. The Huma is attributed to the bearded vulture, and Homa is one of its common names [s1]. So the bird that crowns is a bone-eater of the high cliffs. Its gift arrives slowly, and it arrives whole. Yours does too.

howto: Three parts. Each one takes a while. That is the point.

tabs.label: The long climb
tabs.intro: Earth beneath Earth. Nothing in you is in a hurry.

rows.text: Capricorn is cardinal Earth, ruled by Saturn, the planet of discipline [s4]. The Dragon is yang, courageous and confident, a taker of large risks [s8]. Its branch 辰 (chén) belongs to Earth [s6]. So the ground is doubled under you. The Dragon wants the summit, and Capricorn agrees to walk the whole way up.

rows.k: The bearded vulture does it too
rows.text: It lives most often above 2,000 metres [s2]. Bone makes up 70 to 90 percent of what it eats [s1]. It waits at the cliff edge until the other scavengers have finished [s2]. The hardest food, at the greatest height, taken last. That has always been your order of things.
In the wild it first breeds at about eight years old [s3]. You come into your own late as well. What arrives late in you tends to stay.

tabs.label: What you break open
tabs.intro: The bone others leave, and the marrow inside it.

rows.text: The Greeks called it ossifragus, the bone-breaker [s1]. Their soothsayers counted it among the few birds whose omens were valid [s1]. In Hebrew it is peres, the breaker [s1]. Three peoples looked at the same bird and named the same work.

It carries bones 50 to 150 metres into the air and drops them on stone until they split [s1] [s2]. That is how you take on a hard problem. The Dragon guides list engineer and architect [s8]. Restoration, audit and salvage reward the same patience.
Saturn keeps you saving. The Dragon wants one proud purchase. You make your money where others saw scraps, in the unfashionable skill or the old building with good bones.

tabs.label: Who you build with
tabs.intro: Three who can share a cliff. One who argues over it.
tabs.love_lead: A pair holds several nests in one territory and moves between them from year to year [s2]. Love runs that way for you. You build slowly, and you build more than once. The old pairings name three who can build beside you.

easy.why: The Andean Condor (Capricorn, Rooster year) is your secret friend, since the Rooster is the Dragon's hidden ally, and it flies under your own sign [s6].
The New Caledonian Crow (Virgo, Monkey year) sits in your trine of Rat, Dragon and Monkey, and Virgo is Earth like Capricorn [s6] [s4].
The Superb Bird of Paradise (Taurus, Rooster year) brings the Rooster's friendship again, with Taurus to complete your Earth [s6] [s4].

hard.why: The Giant Otter (Aries, Dog year) is the hard one, because the Dog clashes with the Dragon on the wheel [s6].

story.text: A bearded vulture nest can be used for centuries, by one generation after another [s1].

closing: Build it to last. Someone you will never meet is going to raise their young in it.
